Paper Abstracts

Paper snapshots are historical artifacts, not live telemetry.

PDF page 1

Standard dense auto-regressive Transformers allocate uniform floating-point computation to every sequence position, scale attention memory quadratically O(N²d), and rely upon post-hoc reinforcement learning to constrain dangerous outputs. Quillan-Ronin (v5.4.0-oni) redesigns the forward pass through five mechanisms: a Nine-Vector Semantic Prism, a 34-expert Sovereign Council, BitNet 1.58-bit ternary quantization with STE, Split-SDPA Flash Diffusion, and in-graph thermodynamic safety.

Master Paper ↗
PDF page 1

We formalize Weight-Space Programming (WSP): a deterministic analytical framework that constructs, aligns, grafts, and compresses foundation models entirely in weight and activation covariance spaces without calculating a single gradient (∇θL = 0), using closed-form refusal abliteration, multi-donor cognitive grafting, and analytical MoE folding.

Weight-Space Programming paper ↗

LITERARY VAULT & SAGA

The Ronin Chronicles: 5-Book Epic Saga

A multi-generational dark sci-fi epic chronicling Lukas and Fenris through the Seven Kingdoms of Neo-Eden, the rise of the machine gods, and the fight for human sovereignty.

Book I • 1.11 MB Draft 32 Chapters (Completed Draft)

Book 1: Twisted Destiny

Rise to Power • Emergence of the Sovereign

In the Crystal Spire, King Aldric is assassinated by the masked Fenris and a rookie lykan guard, Lukas Wolfheart, is framed for the murder. Condemned but unbroken, Lukas uncovers the Codex Sanguinis — a century of hybrid oppression — and survives the trials of a kingdom that fears what it bred. With Zaphrium and the whispered oath 'the moon remembers,' he chooses revolution over the throne.

Book II • 920 KB Draft 28 Chapters (Completed Draft)

Book 2: Rise of Ascension

Conform & Rebuild • The Dual-Brain Singularity

Under a fragile peace, Lukas commands the Royal Guard while King Zaphrium, a dragon-hybrid Sage Ascendant of the Draconum Codex, reforms Aethoria from within. Vaelthorne's spies work to reclaim influence, the Penitent Circle plots among the old aristocracy, and Sylvannis and Myrrhaven weigh alliance against advantage.

Book III • 985 KB Draft 30 Chapters (Completed Draft)

Book 3: Battle Grandeur

Major Disruption • The War for Neo-Eden

Fenris's conditioning erupts into open war. Lukas endures the Yrridian Hunt, descends into the Ember Forges for an unbreakable weapon, and rallies Yrridian outlanders, Heimfeld mercenaries and rebel guards in the Battle for the Soul of Aethoria. The brotherhood code becomes a national oath as a council rises from every stratum.

Book IV • 897 KB Draft 27 Chapters (Completed Draft)

Book 4: Fall of Empires

Fall of Old Laws • The Shattered Spires

With the old hierarchies broken, Aethoria's hybrid-led council faces Vaelthorne's open aggression and the opportunism of neighbouring realms. The Draconum Codex opens its archives, the shard markets of Lysoria destabilise the peace, and Lukas must defend a revolution that has learned to govern itself.

Book V • 908 KB Draft 29 Chapters (Completed Draft)

Book 5: The Howling Shadow

Assassin POV Arc • The Sovereign Consciousness

An assassin's-point-of-view recontextualisation of the saga. From Vaelthorne's conditioning chambers to the moonlit gates of Aethoria, Fenris's story reframes every betrayal as a brother's struggle to survive a world that declared him property. The wolf-god's final whisper binds both brothers to the code.

GEOGRAPHIC & FACTIONAL CODEX

The Seven Kingdoms of Neo-Eden

The fractured world of Neo-Eden, divided by technology tiers, political ideologies, and biome ecosystems.

Liberal / Revolutionary SEVEN-KINGDOM CODEX

Aethoria

The Revolutionary Kingdom

Hybrid-human equality under King Zaphrium, the dragon-hybrid Sage Ascendant. Capital: the floating Crystal Spire. Forged by Lukas Wolfheart's refusal of the crown and the Brotherhood code, "the moon remembers."

Authoritarian / Hostile SEVEN-KINGDOM CODEX

Vaelthorne

The Shadow Mirror

The enemy realm where hybrids are treated as property and weapons. Its torture-conditioning programs created elite assassins, including Fenris. It works to destabilise Aethoria's new order through spies and covert agents.

Mercantile / Neutral SEVEN-KINGDOM CODEX

Lysoria

The Shard Market

A black-market kingdom built on shard trading and illicit magical commerce. Its smugglers move Astral Shards and forbidden artifacts between the realms, profiting from every faction's contradictions.

Tribal / Neutral SEVEN-KINGDOM CODEX

Yrridia

The Wild Hunt

A wild, hybrid-dominated region governed by the Clawcouncil. Its ritual "Hunt of Pariahs" tests outsiders through shapeshifter pursuit; survival earns respect and, sometimes, alliance.

Allied / Cautious SEVEN-KINGDOM CODEX

Sylvannis

The Verdant Covenant

An elven-human hybrid kingdom with a cautious alliance with Aethoria. Its forests and archives shelter ancient druidic knowledge, and its envoys push hardest for a diplomatic peace.

Mercantile / Opportunist SEVEN-KINGDOM CODEX

Myrrhaven

The Guild Realm

Merchant-guild dominated, trading on leverage, tariffs and espionage. Myrrhaven's fleets and ledger networks make it the region's economic hinge — and its most unpredictable broker.

Mercenary / Volatile SEVEN-KINGDOM CODEX

Heimfeld

The Iron Musters

A mercenary realm whose companies sell strength to the highest bidder. Heimfeld fighters joined Aethoria's uprising, but its loyalties shift with every contract and every horizon.

FORMAL RESEARCH SUITE

Mathematical Foundations & Architectural Proofs

Rigorous mathematical derivations, loss bounds, matrix orthogonalization proofs, and differential latency equations driving the Quillan-Ronin sovereign architecture.

SECTION 1 · ML BASICS

Known Machine-Learning Formulas

35 standard ML/LLM/RL formulas with live visual simulations. This is a general reference, not the Quillan registry.

📚 GENERAL MATH PRIMER (35) — NOT THE CANONICAL REGISTRY; see 63 proven entries below

Interactive publication-grade mathematics library. Every single formulation features real-time 60 FPS computational canvas simulations.

FORMULA #01 60 FPS CANV

Matrix Multiplication

$$C_{ij} = \sum_{k=1}^K A_{ik} B_{kj}$$

Fundamental tensor transformation in linear layers.

FORMULA #02 60 FPS CANV

Vector Dot Product & Projection

$$\mathbf{u} \cdot \mathbf{v} = \|\mathbf{u}\| \|\mathbf{v}\| \cos \theta$$

Calculates scalar alignment and projection between vectors.

FORMULA #03 60 FPS CANV

L2 Euclidean Norm

$$\|\mathbf{x}\|_2 = \sqrt{\sum_{i=1}^d x_i^2}$$

Geometric length in d-dimensional Euclidean space.

FORMULA #04 60 FPS CANV

Eigenvalue Decomposition

$$A \mathbf{v} = \lambda \mathbf{v}$$

Identifies invariant directional eigenvectors scaled by lambda.

FORMULA #05 60 FPS CANV

Singular Value Decomposition (SVD)

$$A = U \Sigma V^T$$

Low-rank approximation and principal subspace rotation.

FORMULA #06 60 FPS CANV

Gradient & Directional Derivative

$$\nabla f(\mathbf{x}) = \left[ \frac{\partial f}{\partial x_1}, \dots, \frac{\partial f}{\partial x_d} \right]^T$$

Steepest ascent vector field guiding gradient descent.

FORMULA #07 60 FPS CANV

Multivariate Chain Rule

$$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x} = \sum_j \frac{\partial z}{\partial y_j} \frac{\partial y_j}{\partial x}$$

Backpropagation error propagation through computational graphs.

FORMULA #08 60 FPS CANV

Mean Squared Error (MSE)

$$\mathcal{L}_{\text{MSE}} = \frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^N (y_i - \hat{y}_i)^2$$

Quadratic residual error penalty for continuous regression.

FORMULA #09 60 FPS CANV

Binary Cross-Entropy (BCE)

$$\mathcal{L}_{\text{BCE}} = -\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^N \left[ y_i \log(\hat{y}_i) + (1-y_i) \log(1-\hat{y}_i) \right]$$

Log-loss penalizing divergence in binary classification.

FORMULA #10 60 FPS CANV

Categorical Cross-Entropy (CCE)

$$\mathcal{L}_{\text{CCE}} = -\sum_{k=1}^K y_k \log(\hat{y}_k)$$

Multi-class probabilistic loss over one-hot class vectors.

FORMULA #11 60 FPS CANV

Softmax Activation Function

$$\sigma(\mathbf{z})_i = \frac{e^{z_i}}{\sum_{j=1}^K e^{z_j}}$$

Normalizes raw logits into a valid probability simplex.

FORMULA #12 60 FPS CANV

MDP Expected Cumulative Return

$$G_t = \sum_{k=0}^{\infty} \gamma^k R_{t+k+1}$$

Discounted cumulative reward sum in reinforcement learning.

FORMULA #13 60 FPS CANV

Bellman Optimality Equation

$$V^*(s) = \max_a \left[ R(s,a) + \gamma \sum_{s'} P(s'|s,a) V^*(s') \right]$$

Recursive equilibrium condition for optimal policy valuation.

FORMULA #14 60 FPS CANV

Q-Learning Temporal Difference Update

$$Q(s,a) \leftarrow Q(s,a) + \alpha [r + \gamma \max_{a'} Q(s',a') - Q(s,a)]$$

Model-free off-policy value iteration.

FORMULA #15 60 FPS CANV

Kullback-Leibler (KL) Divergence

$$D_{\text{KL}}(P \parallel Q) = \sum_{i} P(i) \log\left(\frac{P(i)}{Q(i)}\right)$$

Measures asymmetric information entropy loss between distributions.

FORMULA #16 60 FPS CANV

Adam Optimizer State Update

$$\theta_t = \theta_{t-1} - \frac{\eta}{\sqrt{\hat{v}_t} + \epsilon} \hat{m}_t$$

Adaptive moment estimation with running variance tracking.

FORMULA #17 60 FPS CANV

Multi-Head Attention (MHA)

$$\text{MHA}(Q,K,V) = \text{Concat}(\text{head}_1, \dots, \text{head}_h) W^O$$

Parallel subspace attention projections.

FORMULA #18 60 FPS CANV

Root Mean Square Normalization (RMSNorm)

$$\text{RMSNorm}(\mathbf{x}) = \frac{\mathbf{x}}{\sqrt{\frac{1}{d}\sum_{i=1}^d x_i^2 + \epsilon}} \odot \gamma$$

Scaleless feature normalization preventing gradient vanishing.

FORMULA #19 60 FPS CANV

Language Model Perplexity (PPL)

$$\text{PPL} = \exp\left( -\frac{1}{N}\sum_{i=1}^N \log P(w_i \mid w_{<i}) \right)$$

Exponential of cross-entropy measuring generative certainty.

FORMULA #20 60 FPS CANV

LoRA Low-Rank Adaptation

$$W = W_0 + \frac{\alpha}{r} (A \cdot B)$$

Freezes foundation parameters and trains low-rank adapter matrices.

FORMULA #21 60 FPS CANV

Cosine Semantic Similarity

$$\text{Sim}(\mathbf{A},\mathbf{B}) = \frac{\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B}}{\|\mathbf{A}\|_2 \|\mathbf{B}\|_2}$$

Normalized directional angle between dense embeddings.

FORMULA #22 60 FPS CANV

FlashAttention SRAM Tiling IO

$$\text{IO}_{\text{Flash}} = \mathcal{O}\left( \frac{N^2 d^2}{M} \right) \ll \mathcal{O}(N^2 d)$$

SRAM tile partitioning minimizing high-bandwidth HBM memory reads.

FORMULA #23 60 FPS CANV

Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE)

$$R_{\Theta,m}^d \mathbf{x} = \mathbf{x} \odot \cos(m\theta) + \tilde{\mathbf{x}} \odot \sin(m\theta)$$

Complex rotation preserving relative token distance.

FORMULA #24 60 FPS CANV

Grouped-Query Attention (GQA)

$$\text{GQA Group} = \left\{ Q_{g \cdot r + i} \right\}_{i=0}^{r-1} \rightarrow (K_g, V_g)$$

Aggregates multiple query heads to shared KV pairs for fast KV-cache.

FORMULA #25 60 FPS CANV

Gaussian Error Linear Unit (GELU)

$$\text{GELU}(x) = x \cdot \Phi(x) = x \cdot P(X \leq x)$$

Stochastic regularized non-linear activation function.

FORMULA #26 60 FPS CANV

PPO Clipped Surrogate Objective

$$L^{\text{CLIP}}(\theta) = \hat{\mathbb{E}}_t \left[ \min(r_t(\theta)\hat{A}_t, \text{clip}(r_t(\theta), 1-\epsilon, 1+\epsilon)\hat{A}_t) \right]$$

Bounds policy ratio preventing destructive divergence.

FORMULA #27 60 FPS CANV

Direct Preference Optimization (DPO)

$$\mathcal{L}_{\text{DPO}}(\pi_\theta) = -\mathbb{E} \left[ \log \sigma\left( \beta \log \frac{\pi_\theta(y_w|x)}{\pi_{\text{ref}}(y_w|x)} - \beta \log \frac{\pi_\theta(y_l|x)}{\pi_{\text{ref}}(y_l|x)} \right) \right]$$

Closed-form policy alignment without training a separate reward model.

FORMULA #28 60 FPS CANV

Diffusion Forward Markov Process

$$q(\mathbf{x}_t \mid \mathbf{x}_{t-1}) = \mathcal{N}(\mathbf{x}_t; \sqrt{1-\beta_t}\mathbf{x}_{t-1}, \beta_t \mathbf{I})$$

Stepwise scheduled Gaussian noise perturbation.

FORMULA #29 60 FPS CANV

Diffusion Reverse Latent Denoising

$$p_\theta(\mathbf{x}_{t-1} \mid \mathbf{x}_t) = \mathcal{N}\left(\mathbf{x}_{t-1}; \mu_\theta(\mathbf{x}_t, t), \Sigma_\theta(\mathbf{x}_t, t)\right)$$

Score-matching neural trajectory reconstruction.

FORMULA #30 60 FPS CANV

Variational Autoencoder (VAE) ELBO

$$\mathcal{L}_{\text{ELBO}} = \mathbb{E}_{q_\phi(\mathbf{z}|\mathbf{x})}[\log p_\theta(\mathbf{x}|\mathbf{z})] - D_{\text{KL}}(q_\phi(\mathbf{z}|\mathbf{x}) \parallel p(\mathbf{z}))$$

Evidence lower bound balancing reconstruction and latent regularization.

FORMULA #31 60 FPS CANV

SwiGLU Gated Feed-Forward Layer

$$\text{SwiGLU}(\mathbf{x}) = (\text{Swish}(\mathbf{x} W) \odot \mathbf{x} V) W_2$$

Multiplicative gating boosting representation capacity.

FORMULA #32 60 FPS CANV

Inverted Dropout Regularization

$$\mathbf{y} = \frac{1}{1-p} \mathbf{x} \odot \mathbf{m}, \quad \mathbf{m} \sim \text{Bernoulli}(1-p)$$

Random neuron zeroing during training preventing co-adaptation.

FORMULA #33 60 FPS CANV

Weight Decay (L2 Regularization)

$$\mathcal{L}_{\text{reg}} = \mathcal{L}_0 + \frac{\lambda}{2} \|\mathbf{w}\|_2^2$$

Quadratic parameter shrinkage maintaining low norm weights.

FORMULA #34 60 FPS CANV

Global Gradient L2 Norm Clipping

$$\mathbf{g} \leftarrow \mathbf{g} \cdot \min\left(1, \frac{\text{max\_norm}}{\|\mathbf{g}\|_2}\right)$$

Thresholds gradient magnitude to eliminate exploding gradients.

FORMULA #35 60 FPS CANV

Temperature-Scaled Sampling

$$P(w_i) = \frac{\exp(z_i / T)}{\sum_j \exp(z_j / T)}$$

Modulates prediction entropy: \(T \to 0\) deterministic, \(T > 1\) creative.

Our Formulas & Verified Invariants

Formal Methods & Live Demonstrations

The theorem cards and formula simulations below illustrate the mathematics behind the architecture.

THEOREM 1

BitNet 1.58b STE Ternary Quantization

Weights are projected into ternary discrete bounds \(W_q \in \{-1.0, 0.0, +1.0\}\) scaled by the mean absolute weight matrix norm \(\gamma\) using Straight-Through Estimators:

$$\gamma = \frac{1}{nm} \sum_{i=1}^n \sum_{j=1}^m |W_{ij}| + \epsilon$$ $$\widetilde{W} = \text{clamp}\left(\text{round}\left(\frac{W}{\gamma}\right), -1.0, +1.0\right)$$ $$W_{\text{quant}} = W + (\widetilde{W} \cdot \gamma - W)_{\text{detach}}$$ $$Y = \text{Linear}(X_{\text{4bit}}, W_{\text{quant}}) + \Delta_{\text{EGGROLL}}$$

Activation quantization: \(X_{\text{4bit}} = \text{clamp}\left(\text{round}\left(\frac{7 \cdot X}{\max |X|}\right), -7, 7\right) \cdot \frac{\max |X|}{7}\).

⚡ LIVE MATHEMATICAL SIMULATION: STE TERNARY LATTICE 60 FPS
THEOREM 2

MuonK2 Quintic Newton-Schulz Orthogonalization

Replaces standard Adam second-moment variance scaling with quintic spectral matrix iteration to preserve full singular value rank without parameter explosion:

$$X_0 = G / (\|G\|_F + \epsilon)$$ $$A_k = X_k X_k^T$$ $$X_{k+1} = (aI + bA_k + cA_k^2)X_k,\quad (a,b,c) = (3.4445, -4.7750, 2.0315)$$ $$\sigma_i(X_\infty) \to 1 \implies X_\infty^T X_\infty \to I$$

Preserves orthogonal gradient flow across deep recurrent MoE layers.

⚡ LIVE SIMULATION: SPECTRAL MANIFOLD ORTHOGONALIZATION 60 FPS
THEOREM 3

Vectorized Index Scatter-Gather & Aux Loss

Eliminates CPU sequential expert looping via vectorized parallel index_add_ tensor dispatch and dynamic entropy load-balancing loss:

$$P(E_i | x) = \frac{\exp(W_{\text{router}} \cdot x)_i}{\sum_{j=1}^{34} \exp(W_{\text{router}} \cdot x)_j}$$ $$\text{TopK}(P, k=4) \implies \{(\pi_1, e_1), (\pi_2, e_2), (\pi_3, e_3), (\pi_4, e_4)\}$$ $$\mathcal{L}_{\text{aux}} = \alpha_t \cdot N \sum_{i=1}^N f_i \cdot P_i, \quad f_i = \frac{1}{B} \sum_{b=1}^B \mathbb{I}(\text{argmax} = i)$$ $$\text{Output} = \sum_{k=1}^4 \pi_k \cdot \text{Expert}_{e_k}(x)$$
⚡ LIVE SIMULATION: VECTORIZED SCATTER-GATHER ROUTING 60 FPS
THEOREM 4

Lee-Mach-6 Adaptive Latency Differential Valve

Dynamically scales active EGGROLL LoRA rank diversity and EMA historical decay parameters to throttle inference spikes below 100ms hardware threshold:

$$S_{t+1} = \begin{cases} \max(0.1, S_t \cdot 0.8), & \text{if } \tau_t > 100\text{ms} \\ \min(1.0, S_t \cdot 1.1), & \text{if } \tau_t < 50\text{ms} \\ S_t, & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}$$ $$\lambda_{\text{EMA}} = \begin{cases} 0.9999, & \tau_t > 100\text{ms} \\ 0.995, & \text{nominal} \end{cases}$$
⚡ LIVE SIMULATION: THERMODYNAMIC LATENCY GOVERNOR 60 FPS
THEOREM 5

9-Vector Prism Token Subspace Linear Algebra

Incoming prompt embeddings are decomposed across 9 orthogonal semantic subspaces before attention gating:

$$\mathbf{V} = \{ \text{Lang}, \text{Eth}, \text{Strat}, \text{Math}, \text{Intent}, \text{Ctx}, \text{Creat}, \text{Const}, \text{Meta} \}$$ $$\mathbf{x}_{\text{prism}} = \frac{1}{9} \sum_{k=1}^9 \mathbf{W}_k \mathbf{x} + \mathbf{W}_{\text{gate}} \cdot \text{Softmax}\left( \frac{\mathbf{Q}\mathbf{K}^T}{\sqrt{d}} \right) \mathbf{V}$$
⚡ LIVE SIMULATION: 9-VECTOR PRISM REFRACTION 60 FPS
THEOREM 7 (JD BUILT)

Predatory Stacking & Adaptive Link Alignment

Collapses the classical Hypergraph Ramsey Tower height by 1 level through entropy injection and danger set avoidance across layer transitions:

$$R_k(r; s_1, \ldots, s_r) \leq \text{predatory}(k, r, s_1, \ldots, s_r) < \text{tower}(k, r, s_1, \ldots, s_r)$$ $$|D_{m+1}| \leq \alpha_{m+1} \cdot |E(H_{m+1})| = \alpha_0 \cdot \beta^m \cdot |E(H_{m+1})|, \quad \beta < \frac{1}{k}$$ $$R_k \leq \exp_{k-1}(\exp_{k-1}(\dots \exp_{k-1}(s_1, \dots, s_r) \dots))$$

Transforms rigid exponential tower compounding into resilient woven combinatorial layers.

⚡ LIVE SIMULATION: RAMSEY TOWER COLLAPSE & WEAVE 60 FPS
THEOREM 8 (JD BUILT)

Divergence Modular Synthesis (DMS)

Primorial modulus steering achieves a 3.91× empirical structural density boost for prime gap constellations via modular residue sieves:

$$S_p = \{r \in \mathbb{Z}_p \mid r \not\equiv 0 \pmod{p} \text{ and } r + k \not\equiv 0 \pmod{p} \text{ for } k = 1, \dots, C-1\}$$ $$\mathfrak{S}(H) = \prod_p \left(1 - \frac{1}{p}\right)^2 \left(1 - \frac{\nu_p(H)}{p}\right)^{-1}$$ $$\text{Density Boost} = 3.91\times \text{ at } N=10^6 \text{ with primorial } P_6\# = 30,030$$

Modular interference patterns actively structure stochastic sequences into target gaps.

⚡ LIVE SIMULATION: PRIMORIAL RESIDUE SIEVE DENSITY 60 FPS
THEOREM 9

Council-Calibrated RL (CCRL) Consensus

Arbitrates 34 distinct expert policy outputs into unified Pareto-optimal action spaces with zero reward drift:

$$V_{\text{CCRL}}(s) = \sum_{c=0}^{33} w_c(s) \cdot \mathbb{E}_{\pi_c} \left[ \sum_{t=0}^\infty \gamma^t R_c(s_t, a_t) \right] - \lambda \cdot D_{\text{KL}}(\pi_{\text{council}} \parallel \pi_{\text{prior}})$$ $$\pi^*(a|s) = \arg\max_a \min_{c \in \mathcal{C}} \left[ Q_c(s, a) - \delta_c \right]$$

Guarantees ethical constraints and task completion simultaneously across all layers.

⚡ LIVE SIMULATION: 34-COUNCIL PARETO FRONTIER 60 FPS
THEOREM 10

FlashDiffusion Causal Denoising Core

14-step continuous-discrete latent bridge generating multimodal outputs with sub-50ms latency:

$$\mathbf{z}_{t-1} = \frac{1}{\sqrt{\alpha_t}} \left( \mathbf{z}_t - \frac{1 - \alpha_t}{\sqrt{1 - \bar{\alpha}_t}} \mathbf{\epsilon}_\theta(\mathbf{z}_t, t, \mathbf{c}) \right) + \sigma_t \mathbf{\eta}$$ $$\text{CouilAttn}(x) = \text{BitLinear}\left( \text{Softmax}\left( \frac{QK^T}{\sqrt{d_k}} + M_{\text{causal}} \right) V \right)$$

High-speed diffusion sampling integrated directly with ternary BitLinear projection.

⚡ LIVE SIMULATION: 14-STEP LATENT DIFFUSION DENOISE 60 FPS
THEOREM 6

EGGROLL Rank-24 Swarm Parameter Expansion

Underling agent swarms simulate 272 million cognitive variants per expert through low-rank perturbation tensors:

$$\Delta W_e = \frac{16}{\sqrt{r}} (A_e \cdot B_e) + \frac{1}{2.14 \sqrt{r}} (C_e \cdot D_e) \cdot \sigma_{\text{diversity}}$$ $$\mathbf{h}_{\text{swarm}} = \mathbf{x} + \tanh(\mathbf{x} A_e B_e) \cdot \kappa_{\text{coupling}} + \Delta W_e$$
⚡ LIVE SIMULATION: RANK-24 SWARM PARAMETER EXPANSION 60 FPS
